edits.after:
name = "rpncalc"
description = "Interactive RPN calculator"
version = "1.4.1"

[extra.fortitude.check]
ignore = [
    "C003",
    "S231",
    "S241",

[fortran]
source-form = "default"

scope: Numerical routines from the RPN calculator, called directly without its interactive interface. The checked main verifies a negative cube root, sinc and sech at zero, beta(2,3), modified Bessel I0 at zero, and integer gcd/lcm against known results. A checksum-guarded manifest correction sets source-form=default so .f and .f90 files use their respective forms. No numerical sources are changed. The tests do not establish accuracy over full argument ranges or validate the complete calculator.
compatibility_edits: Set [fortran] source-form="default" in the prepared manifest. FPM selects fixed form for .f files and free form for .f90 files. No numerical source edits.
